title: The Seal Hunters
text: Hunters wrapped in furs club seals by a breathing hole until the snow is red. They have a fire going in a ring of bones and offer to share it. They keep glancing at the dark beyond the light.

options.label: Share their fire, and do not ask what they fear.

outcomes.text: You are warmed and fed and full of their stories. None of you look at the dark either.

options.label: The shrewdest trades for their furs against the cold to come.

outcomes.text: The furs are thick and warm. They turn the cold like armor.

options.label: The Leader asks what else hunts the ice, and why they keep watching the dark.

outcomes.text: They tell you what hunts the ice, and where. Only when they are done do they stop glancing at the dark.
